text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Right now, I am offering 
detailed explanations of the "DREAMS 
Project" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: <username>, do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what would you like me to 
explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything you'd like to ask 
regarding the training in the "DREAMS 
Project"—
choice_data_list: About the Review and Strategy Meeting

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About "DREAMS," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Breeders' Cup expedition project, 
"DREAMS." As a member of this project, I 
will aim to conquer the BC alongside my 
teammates.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In this training scenario, there are no 
target races for individual Umamusume; you 
will be training them toward conquering 
the BC.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The BC is held in the first half of 
November of the Senior Year. At that time, 
the BC race you selected earlier will 
become your Umamusume's final target 
race."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Friendly competition among team members 
will help develop the skills of not just 
your trainee, but the entire team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Between now and the expedition to the BC, 
a total of five reviews will be conducted. 
During these reviews, your team's 
accomplishments up to that point will be 
evaluated."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Target Team Ranks are set for each review. 
Strengthen your team through well-planned 
training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding 
"DREAMS." Is there anything else you'd 
like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'd like to know about "Team Members," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Within DREAMS, 3 specific Umamusume will 
continue their activities as team members, 
working in close coordination with your 
trainee Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Team members appear in training separately 
from Support Card Umamusume and Tracen 
Academy staff, offering you their 
assistance.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Depending on a team member's "Member 
Rank," you'll gain even more stats when 
training alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Training with your team members will fill 
their "Dream Gauge."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In addition to training, you can also gain 
Dream Gauge by resting, going out, 
visiting the infirmary, or running in 
target races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Training with a member whose gauge has 
been filled 3 times to max will grant more 
stat gains.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, members' ranks will 
increase. Increasing rank will reset the 
Dream Gauge.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Team Rank is determined by your lowest 
member's rank. As your Team Rank 
increases, effects like Friendship Bonuses 
will be boosted!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation about Team 
Members. Is there anything else you'd like 
to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'd like to know about "Reviews and 
Strategy Meetings," then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
During the "Review," reaching your Team 
Rank goal will be evaluated. Achieving 
your goal earns high praise! Your trainee 
Umamusume will grow significantly!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
After the review, a "Strategy Meeting" 
will be held. In the strategy meeting, 
you'll decide training guidelines to make 
your team even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There are 3 types of guidelines: 
"Physical," "Technique," and "Mental." 
Together, they are called "Team 
Parameters."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Each parameter has a level, and the 
higher it is, the more effective 'DREAMS 
Training' becomes. I'll explain more about 
that separately."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can use DREAMS Points, or "DP" for 
short, to raise the level of each team 
parameter.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The amount of DP you earn changes 
depending on how many times team members' 
ranks increase and their evaluation during 
reviews, so be sure to train with your 
members proactively!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that once DP is used, it 
cannot be reallocated, so be careful.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation for 
"Reviews and Strategy Meetings." Is there 
anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About "DREAMS Training," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In "DREAMS Training," 3 members plus up to 
5 members from your support card lineup 
will appear across all trainings at the 
same time!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With intensive training, you can help your 
trainee Umamusume grow substantially.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
DREAMS Training will become available to 
activate after the initial Strategy 
Meeting held shortly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
DREAMS Training is exceptionally powerful, 
but additional effects will trigger based 
on the Team Stats enhanced during the 
Strategy Meetings.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The number of times you can use DREAMS 
Training before the next reflection is 
limited. Make sure to choose the right 
moments to use it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Your available activations will recover 
during reviews, but they won't exceed the 
maximum capacity, so be sure to use them 
up before the next review."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding 
"DREAMS Training." Is there anything else 
you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a 
brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any 
time by tapping the 'i' button in the top 
left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck. I'll be cheering 
you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best, 
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
